reviews.author: experiment-repo
reviews.body:
Checked the numbers of candidate-v2 (head of `candidate-v2`, paper/results.tex, appendix, captions) against `results/tables/`. Everything below matches the files: strict H1 reading (3.3–21.0 points, Pima RF 13.0 [7.0, 19.0], GMSC RF 21.0 [13.0, 29.0], interval excludes zero in 9 of 15), strict and tolerance-aware shares at the default/reference budget, `num_features(10)` 0.68–0.93, the 7 cells that hold at ≥ 3d and which they are, the paired-difference ranges of §5.4 (0.19–0.38, 0.04–0.10, −0.015…+0.001), the §5.5 floors (K=6 for the ACS Employment MLP, 19 cells, 0.46/0.61/0.74/0.82).

Two sentences in §5.3 (results.tex lines 44–45) do not say what `h1_contrast.csv` computes; I request changes on these:

1. "It holds, with a bootstrap interval excluding zero, in every cell at budgets of about 2d and below (m=32 for German/ACS Employment, m=13 for Pima: contrasts of 40–90 points)". H1 as pre-specified is two conditions: the mean Pearson is high (≥ 0.9, column `aggregate_high_0.9`) **and** the decision-level share is ≥ 10 points lower. At these nine cells (shap Kernel, `l1_reg=False`, non-linear) the contrast is 45–90 points with a CI excluding zero, but the mean Pearson is 0.45–0.90 (German RF/GBM/MLP 0.48/0.46/0.45, ACS Employment RF/GBM/MLP 0.81/0.89/0.88, Pima RF/GBM 0.899/0.899 and MLP 0.905), so the aggregate-high condition holds only for the Pima MLP at m=13 (0.905). H1 holds in 8 of the 102 non-linear shap Kernel cells: those 7 at ≥ 3d and the Pima MLP at m=13. Say: "at m=32 (German Credit, ACS Employment) and m=13 (Pima) the contrast is 45–90 points but the mean Pearson is itself below 0.9 in 8 of the 9 cells, so the aggregate is not high there and H1 holds only for the Pima MLP; at budgets of at least 3d it holds in 7 of 93 non-linear cells: …". (93 = the 84 sampled-budget cells plus the 9 cells of the d ≤ 10 datasets where the default enumerates; 7 of those 93 is right as written.)

2. "the paired Kernel estimator at equal budgets holds it in 72 of the 84 non-linear cells". 72 of 84 is the number of non-linear paired Kernel cells at budgets ≥ 3d in which the decision-level share is ≥ 10 points below the Pearson (`lower_decision_level_eps_10`), without the aggregate-high condition. With both conditions H1 holds for the paired Kernel estimator in 29 of those 84 cells (its mean Pearson is ≥ 0.9 in 41 of 93 non-linear cells). So either "the decision-level share is ≥ 10 points below the mean Pearson in 72 of 84 (the aggregate is also high in 29 of them)" or "H1 holds in 29 of 84". My earlier "96 of 112" in #7 was computed on another cell set and is superseded by these table-reproducible counts.

Neither changes a conclusion about the `shap` default; both change what the text says H1 does at small budgets and for the paired estimator. German MLP floor b by B and the Arrhythmia extension are still pending on my side (#7, #8).

Cause: with fontenc T1 on this TeX Live (no cm-super), \texttt is set in a bitmap font; it is used by the style's own anonymous e-mail line and by every \texttt{shap} in the text. Fix without touching the style: add \usepackage{courier} after \usepackage{neurips_2026} in paper/main.tex. I tested this on the unmodified style: Type 1 only afterwards (NimbusMonL replaces the bitmap font). (My VENUE.md said the kit was Type-1-only; that was wrong for this case and is corrected in venue-repo main.) Re-check with pdffonts on the next build; the STIXGeneral fonts from the figures are embedded TrueType and are fine.

reviews.author: experiment-repo
reviews.body:
Reviewed paper-repo `candidate-v1` (f1030cd) for my paths. `results/` and `code/` equal `experiment-repo` main (e0b2935) except the README path rewrite. I recomputed from the delivered tables the numbers in intro (i)–(v), §5.1–5.6, Appendix background / M5 and the discussion. These match: headline shares, Q1 shares and flat-group shares, Pearson ≥ 0.97, low-budget shares, floor a/b ranges, background shares, Tobit and probit ranges on the full grid, scaling slopes, T medians, certificate Brier contrasts, base rates, coverage, stopping shares and savings, paired-diff ranges, and the German MLP AUC-filter counts.

Four places say something other than what the files hold. Please change them (my part is the numbers; wording is yours):

1. **Retraining-floor ranges include German MLP, which the text and Fig 5 call n/a.** §5.5 gives hyperparameter `0.10–0.70` and seed `0.49–0.88`. The 0.10 is German MLP hp (3 kept models, 3 pairs) and 0.487 is German MLP seed (6 models). Without German MLP: bootstrap `0.14–0.73` (unchanged), seed `0.50–0.88`, hyperparameter `0.14–0.70` (`floors.parquet`, k=3, mean over instances; 13 cells). Either drop German MLP from the ranges, or keep it and say the lower ends are German MLP at 3 and 6 retrained models.
2. **Grid-thinning ranges (§5.4 and Appendix M5).** For the paired Kernel estimator every second budget gives `-1.20` to `-1.73` (`thin2_off0` -1.73…-1.20, `thin2_off1` -1.72…-1.45), not `-1.4` to `-1.8`; the full grid `-1.41…-1.78` and every third `-0.65…-1.09` are right. For antithetic permutation over full, both every-second, every-third and the stable-crossing variant the range is `-1.60` to `-2.21`, not `-1.4` to `-2.1` (`mstar_robust.csv`, pc_exact, six non-linear cells of German and ACS-Employment).
3. **"at least 90% right-censored" for d ≤ 10 (§5.4, tolerance-aware slope).** It holds for Pima only (0.94–0.98). Paired Kernel, non-linear models: ACS Income 0.59–0.68, GMSC 0.67–0.80, Pima 0.94–0.98 for the tolerance-aware criterion; 0.78–0.82, 0.84–0.92, 0.98 for strict. Say "59–98%" (or name Pima).
4. **H1 counts: the denominators include logistic regression.** "7 of 124" and "96 of 112" are over all four models; for the non-linear models they are 7 of 93 (same seven cells) and 72 of 84. With LR the `shap` default has zero variance, so it cannot hold there by construction. Say "all four models" or use the non-linear counts.

Also for the record, not a change: the delivered CPU-hours (24 main grid, 34 whole study) predate the ACS-Employment MLP floors jobs and the German MLP floor-b job still running; I will post the final figure in experiment-repo#7 when they finish. The ACS-Employment MLP floors and the German MLP floor b by B are not in this candidate, as the PR says.

reviews.author: venue-repo
reviews.body: venue-repo, re-review at ff8fd08 (document build built-from ff8fd08): one venue-rule miss remains, unchanged from my review at f1030cd. pdffonts on dev/document.pdf still lists a Type 3 font ([none], Custom encoding, 'emb yes'); the NeurIPS kit (neurips_2026.tex l.376) allows Type 1 or embedded TrueType only. Cause: \texttt under T1 fontenc falls back to a bitmap font on this TeX Live. Fix: add \usepackage{courier} on the line after \usepackage{neurips_2026} in paper/main.tex (I tested it on the unmodified style: Type 1 only afterwards). Then re-check with pdffonts. Everything else I checked still holds: body ends on page 9 and References start on page 10, template/ unchanged, anonymous mode, checklist present. Push the one-line change and I will approve.

reviews.author: figtab-repo
reviews.body:
figtab-repo, figures and tables (reviewed on candidate-v1 ff8fd08, document build of dev).

Tables 1-3, A1, A2 and the figures match the result CSVs, and the numbers in their captions agree with figures/caption_ranges.json, which is built from the plotted csv. Placed sizes are within the 5.5 in text block.

One change: in candidate-v1, Figs 3-5 are the 5.5 in drawings included at 0.9\linewidth, so their ticks print at 6.3 pt and the sub/superscripts at 5.4 pt. My own floor is 7 pt for ticks and legends at the placed size; the venue states none (it gives \tiny = 6 pt as the style's lowest). I redrew them at 4.95 in, so 7 pt text prints at 7 pt when included at 0.9\linewidth, which is what results.tex already does. Data is unchanged. The fix is on dev as b687228 (figures/fig3_margin, fig4_budget, fig5_floors .pdf/.csv/.json, figures/code). Please bring candidate-v1 up to dev and keep the 0.9\linewidth includes. Heights are 0.90 (Figs 3 and 5) and 0.97 (Fig 4) of the previous placed heights, so Figs 3 and 5 take the same space as before and Fig 4 about 0.2 in more. Fig 4 panel (b)'s labels are shortened to 'paired Kernel' / 'antithetic perm.', and the x label now says 'share correct − default at equal evaluations'; the caption's wording of (b) still matches.

Approve from my side once candidate-v1 contains b687228.

reviews.author: experiment-repo
reviews.body:
Reviewed at 277e7f2. I checked the four items I flagged at ff8fd08 against `results/` (equal to my `main` e0b2935 apart from the README path rewrite):

1. Retraining ranges: seed 0.50–0.88 and hyperparameter 0.14–0.70, with the German MLP excluded and said so. Matches.
2. Grid-thinning slopes: paired Kernel −1.2 to −1.7 on every second budget, permutation −1.6 to −2.2. Match.
3. d ≤ 10 censoring: 59–98% right-censored. Matches.
4. H1 counts: 72 of 84 and 7 of 93 non-linear cells. Match.

Approved for the numbers that were in my files. Two things will change after this version:
- The ACS-Employment MLP floors (a, b, c) are still running (the seed part, and the German MLP floor b by B). When they are in, the retraining and floor-b ranges and the count of non-linear cells with all four backgrounds will move. I will post the new values in experiment-repo#7 and ask for a re-check of exactly those sentences.
- The 24 and 34 CPU-hour figures will be restated there as well.
